scoring_rules_extra.rule: Find underlyings from GET /api/automation/reddit (ingest first). Rank mentions in allowed_symbols. This lane's strategy allows a larger debit and 2 contracts — still prefer 1 contract unless the chain is tight and two sources are strong.
New entries need a named Reddit mention plus tape or a fillable 1DTE chain (next session). If the name has no 1DTE listing, skip — do not buy a weekly. Size must still fit max_option_debit_usd.
